planets.name: TOI-2194 b
planets.description: TOI-2194 b crosses its star every 15.3 days and is 2.0 times as wide as Earth, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-2194 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2194. Its orbit and size follow Mistry et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
